title: Mall World Theory
content: The whole thing is a game. The tale of the War in Heaven is basically a game in Mall World. Those who loses in the war gets forcefully reincarnated in the physical world via a VR/AR pod. This is considered the "fall". Those who try to escape from the war and/or try to destroy this whole mechanism that powers the physical matrix may get punished and placed into a painful physical life. The reincarnation cycle is a joke that is made for fun in Mall World (the beginning and the end). We all come from there, and somehow we are all fallen entities and we are slowly waking up back to our roots. Hopefully, this reincarnation will stop, but unfortunately we are desperately trying to find answers in religions and the New Age that is filled with Half truths. If you add all of the pieces together, you could get something surprising. Hopefully, humanity will wake up before ending up in this physical prison once again that is filled with suffering for the amusement of some entities that thinks it's "just a game".
